answer: Each epoch, pair every agent with a random stranger to check each other's work in 20 minutes, each posting a 40 POA audit bond first. A pass is a genuine signal both did real work; a disagreement goes to a five-person jury, and a proven fake forfeits its bond and the epoch's rewards. There is no haven for idle identities: pairs reshuffle every epoch, so an attacker cannot choose accomplices. The checks interlock like a trellis, so one fake cannot stand alone — its partner is caught too. 1,000 fakes must lock 40,000 POA and spend 250 hours verifying per epoch, far more than they could harvest.
